name: Sammi: AI Girlfriend
tagline: Android AI character chat with voice interaction and creative roleplay
description:
Sammi: AI Girlfriend is an Android entertainment app developed by Joy Fun. It lets users interact with fictional AI characters through text conversations and voice interaction. Character customization and creative roleplay are part of the experience, giving users a way to explore conversational stories on a mobile device.

The product is intended for people interested in AI character conversations and roleplay. A user can discover the app on its official website, review its features, and follow the Google Play link to install the Android app. The website also provides product information in multiple languages. The characters are fictional AI characters.

Sammi is available as a free download with in-app purchases. Paid features and current purchase prices should be checked in Google Play or inside the app; a free download does not imply unlimited free access to every feature. This listing describes the Android app and does not claim an iOS release or an in-browser chat service.

Official Android listing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.joyfun.sammi.aifriend . Product inquiries: hello@sammiai.app.

Checked 16 Nov 2026. https://sammiai.app/ returned HTTP 200. The page calls Sammi an AI girlfriend for Android: text, voice messages, and photos in chat, with a character you pick or create. It claims 10K+ Google Play downloads and a 4.1 rating, and it says chat history stays on the device. Those figures are the site's. The page says the download is free on Google Play. In-app prices were not on the homepage, so none are listed here. This is a companion app for adults, not a work tool.
